title: PDP / Product Image Gallery
description:
<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-0">:person_with_crown:</custom> **User Story:**

**As a** user browsing a product detail page,  
**I want** to view high-quality images of the product and easily navigate between them,  
**so that** I can evaluate the product visually before making a purchase decision.

‌

---

### **Functional Requirements**

* Support a minimum of 1-n images per product.
* Image types supported: JPEG, PNG, WebP.
* Responsive scaling of images with optimization for loading speed (lazy loading recommended).
* Support for videos or 360° views as additional media items (optional).
* Fallback behavior if images fail to load (e.g., "Image unavailable" message).
* Gallery image background color is choosable

### **Non-Functional Requirements**

* **Performance**: Gallery should load and become interactive in under 1 second.
* **Responsiveness**: Must work seamlessly across all modern browsers and screen sizes.
* **Accessibility**: Fully WCAG 2.1 AA compliant.
* **Localization**: Support left-to-right and right-to-left languages.
* **Analytics**: Track image interactions (e.g., clicks, swipes, zooms).

longDescription:
## Purpose

The Product Image Gallery enables customers to view comprehensive product imagery through high-quality images with intuitive navigation. It serves as a critical component for informed purchasing decisions by allowing detailed visual product evaluation.

## Use Cases

- Navigating through multiple product images in a gallery with thumbnail navigation
- Viewing images in a fullscreen lightbox with zoom and pan functionality
- Swiping through images on mobile with touch-friendly pagination indicators
- Hovering over thumbnails on desktop for quick image preview

## Design Rationale

The gallery implements distinct interaction patterns for mobile and desktop to optimize the user experience on each platform. Mobile uses a swipeable carousel without thumbnails to maximize screen space, while desktop provides a vertical thumbnail strip for quick navigation. Performance is prioritized through lazy loading and optimized image delivery. Full WCAG 2.1 AA compliance ensures accessibility for all users through keyboard navigation and screen reader support.
shortDescription: The Product Image Gallery enables customers to view comprehensive product imagery through high-quality images with intuitive navigation. Mobile uses a swipeable carousel without thumbnails to maximize screen space, while desktop provides a vertical thumbnail strip for quick navigation. Performance is prioritized through lazy loading and optimized image delivery. Hovering over thumbnails on desktop provides quick image preview, and tapping images opens a fullscreen lightbox with pinch-to-zoom support.
